findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Frequent temporary allocations increase GC activity and memory traffic without adding durable value.
findings.likely_impact: Higher heap pressure, more garbage collection, and reduced steady-state performance.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reuse mutable helpers where safe, pre-size collections, or move allocations outside the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Cutting temporary objects reduces bytes allocated and the CPU spent reclaiming them.

findings.title: List membership checks inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 307 performs `.contains(...)` checks that may scan collections repeatedly.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated linear scans inside iteration can push runtime toward O(n^2) as data sets grow.
findings.likely_impact: Throughput degradation and elevated CPU time for larger inputs.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use a `Set` for membership lookups or pre-index data before the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Indexing once avoids repeated scans and reduces wasted CPU work.

findings.title: Nested loop with repeated lookup work
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 307 is nested at depth 2 and also performs repeated lookup or transformation work.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Nested iteration plus repeated lookup operations multiplies work and can become expensive quickly as data grows.
findings.likely_impact: Poor scalability, longer batch runtimes, and excess CPU consumption.
findings.recommended_remediation: Pre-index shared data, reduce nested scans, or collapse passes where possible.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Lowering algorithmic complexity reduces operations and energy for the same user-visible result.

findings.title: Repeated setup or parsing inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 307 recreates parsers, formatters, mappers, regexes, or other setup-heavy objects.

findings.likely_impact: Higher latency, avoidable GC churn, and lower throughput on larger collections.

findings.low_waste_rationale: Reusing expensive helpers reduces instructions executed and memory churn per item processed.

findings.low_waste_rationale: Blocking or event-driven coordination cuts useless instructions and improves value per watt.

findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated external calls inside iteration amplify latency and often create N+1 style traffic.
findings.likely_impact: Slower batch processing, more round trips, and higher infrastructure cost.
findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.

findings.title: Direct thread creation

findings.likely_impact: Thread proliferation, unstable latency, and reduced machine efficiency under load.
findings.recommended_remediation: Route work through bounded executors or structured concurrency instead of raw thread creation.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Bounding concurrency avoids excess parallel overhead and keeps CPU use closer to useful work.

findings.title: Polling loop without blocking
findings.what_was_found: while loop at line 573 appears to poll shared state without a blocking primitive.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: A polling loop repeatedly burns CPU to recheck readiness instead of sleeping until useful work can continue.
findings.likely_impact: Higher CPU utilization, thermal pressure, and reduced throughput for other work on the same host.
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace polling with a blocking primitive, callback, latch, queue, or at least bounded backoff.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Blocking or event-driven coordination cuts useless instructions and improves value per watt.

findings.title: Allocation-heavy loop body
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 650 allocates new collections, builders, or mapping helpers during iteration.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Frequent temporary allocations increase GC activity and memory traffic without adding durable value.
findings.likely_impact: Higher heap pressure, more garbage collection, and reduced steady-state performance.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reuse mutable helpers where safe, pre-size collections, or move allocations outside the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Cutting temporary objects reduces bytes allocated and the CPU spent reclaiming them.

findings.title: Repeated setup or parsing inside loop

findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Rebuilding invariant helpers during each iteration spends CPU cycles and allocations on work that can usually be reused.
findings.likely_impact: Higher latency, avoidable GC churn, and lower throughput on larger collections.
findings.recommended_remediation: Hoist reusable helpers outside the loop and cache invariant computations.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Reusing expensive helpers reduces instructions executed and memory churn per item processed.

findings.title: Remote or service call inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 68 contains calls that look like repository, client, network, or database access.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated external calls inside iteration amplify latency and often create N+1 style traffic.
findings.likely_impact: Slower batch processing, more round trips, and higher infrastructure cost.
findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.

findings.title: Allocation-heavy loop body
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 248 allocates new collections, builders, or mapping helpers during iteration.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Frequent temporary allocations increase GC activity and memory traffic without adding durable value.
findings.likely_impact: Higher heap pressure, more garbage collection, and reduced steady-state performance.
findings.recommended_remediation: Reuse mutable helpers where safe, pre-size collections, or move allocations outside the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Cutting temporary objects reduces bytes allocated and the CPU spent reclaiming them.

findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Nested iteration plus repeated lookup operations multiplies work and can become expensive quickly as data grows.
findings.likely_impact: Poor scalability, longer batch runtimes, and excess CPU consumption.
findings.recommended_remediation: Pre-index shared data, reduce nested scans, or collapse passes where possible.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Lowering algorithmic complexity reduces operations and energy for the same user-visible result.

findings.title: Repeated setup or parsing inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 372 recreates parsers, formatters, mappers, regexes, or other setup-heavy objects.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Rebuilding invariant helpers during each iteration spends CPU cycles and allocations on work that can usually be reused.
findings.likely_impact: Higher latency, avoidable GC churn, and lower throughput on larger collections.
findings.recommended_remediation: Hoist reusable helpers outside the loop and cache invariant computations.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Reusing expensive helpers reduces instructions executed and memory churn per item processed.

findings.title: Remote or service call inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 50 contains calls that look like repository, client, network, or database access.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated external calls inside iteration amplify latency and often create N+1 style traffic.
findings.likely_impact: Slower batch processing, more round trips, and higher infrastructure cost.
findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.

findings.title: Remote or service call inside loop
findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 398 contains calls that look like repository, client, network, or database access.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: Repeated external calls inside iteration amplify latency and often create N+1 style traffic.
findings.likely_impact: Slower batch processing, more round trips, and higher infrastructure cost.
findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.

findings.low_waste_rationale: Bounding concurrency avoids excess parallel overhead and keeps CPU use closer to useful work.

findings.title: Polling loop without blocking
findings.what_was_found: while loop at line 573 appears to poll shared state without a blocking primitive.
findings.why_it_is_wasteful: A polling loop repeatedly burns CPU to recheck readiness instead of sleeping until useful work can continue.
findings.likely_impact: Higher CPU utilization, thermal pressure, and reduced throughput for other work on the same host.
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace polling with a blocking primitive, callback, latch, queue, or at least bounded backoff.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Blocking or event-driven coordination cuts useless instructions and improves value per watt.

findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.

findings.what_was_found: Loop at line 50 contains calls that look like repository, client, network, or database access.

findings.recommended_remediation: Batch external calls, prefetch data before iterating, or aggregate writes after the loop.
findings.low_waste_rationale: Fewer round trips and fewer bytes moved per useful action reduce time and energy spent waiting on I/O.
